# Paper vehicle reference code

Snapshot of `paper-plugin/src/main/java` from
[ExMarius/MrCrayfishVehicleMod](https://github.com/ExMarius/MrCrayfishVehicleMod)
revision `6ff2f1da494e7861d14c6772b2bdbcbc2a70ade0`. The source is retained for
porting/reference under the upstream GPLv3 terms in `LICENSE`. This is **not**
the new plugin and is not compiled or enabled by it. No upstream models,
textures, sounds, deployment configuration, or resource pack are included.
Some code references original assets; do not activate it unchanged without
reviewing dependencies, attribution, and asset rights. This snapshot does not
represent a claim that its features have been tested in this repository.
